name: FORNO® Salerno 33" 15.6 Cu. Ft. Stainless Steel Built-In Side-by-Side Refrigerator
shortDescription: The Salerno 33" side-by-side frost-free refrigerator with decorative grill trim comes equipped with the latest technology, including temperature control system that adjusts temperatures to keep food and beverages fresh. A simple Led touch panel allows for easy access and control of all features.

features.text: 9.54 cu.ft of fresh food storage is equipped with 3 adjustable glass shelves, 2 crisper drawers, 2 door basket bins and 1 door gallon bin.
6.08 cu.ft of freezer storage is also equipped with 3 adjustable glass shelves, 2 crisper drawerss, 2 door basket bins and 1 door gallon bin.
The Side-by-Side design ensures that the majority of your food items are conveniently located at eye level, allowing for easy visibility and quick access to your desired items.
The new modern trim kit design adds a touch of elegance to your kitchen decor by providing a built-in appearance that enhances the overall aesthetic of your kitchen.
The spill-proof shelves offer a hassle-free solution for cleaning up spills, allowing you to swiftly and effortlessly address any mess without creating additional difficulty.
Simple Led Touch temperature control features provide superior accuracy in temperature regulation while providing easy and intuitive use.
The Fast Freeze & The Fast Cool Function empowers you to efficiently preserve a substantial amount of room temperature food in the freezer & in the fridge.
The fingerprint-resistant stainless steel finish enhances the appearance of your unit, maintaining a fresh and new look by minimizing the visibility of fingerprints.
The inclusion of LED lights in both compartments ensures convenient visibility, making it effortless to locate and retrieve the specific item you desire.
Frost-free refrigerator comes with a multi air flow cooling system that ensures an even temperature throughout the fridge.
The clear door shelves will amplify your refrigerator storage capacity even for the largest containers.
